theorems.name: Submission.ind_top_orthonormal_frame_sign
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (τ : Fin n → Eucl n), Orthonormal ℝ τ → simpleNVector τ = simpleNVector (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∨ simpleNVector τ = -simpleNVector (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))
